review.assessment:
This change introduces latency/percentiles.py with a nearest-rank percentile calculator, but the index formula int(n * p) consistently overshoots by one rank for standard window sizes. Consequently, value_at returns the maximum observation instead of the specified percentile boundary, violating the documented computation rules.

Defect 1:
- call: python -c "from latency.percentiles import value_at; print(value_at(list(range(1, 21)), 0.95))"
- expected: 19 (the nineteenth observation in a sorted sequence)
- actual: 20 (the twentieth observation / maximum)

findings.defect: index = int(n * p) computes the nineteenth percentile of twenty samples as index 19 (the maximum), whereas the specification requires index 18.
